SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution ? (1 mark)

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution .

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Human Breathing System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Human Breathing System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing System.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Classification of Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Classification of Plants.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Classification of Plants.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Classification of Plants.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Pollution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Pollution.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Pollution.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat transfer? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat transfer.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Heat transfer.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat transfer.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat transfer.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy.

18. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking 14 3.2. Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number .

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly
